notes.title: Xmas Event Announcement!
notes.content:
Dear Player,

We are excited to announce that the Xmas Event has just begun and will last till January 6th.

During this period you may collect candies to obtain tons of free coins and powerful rewards.

You may find the Xmas quests in the achievement screen:
[list]
[*]Candies for gold - collect 500 candies to get 1000 coins;
[*]Xmas Gift - collect 3000 candies to obtain the "Santa's Boots";
[*]The Coins Multiplier - Transform into snowmen and kill 100 players to collect triple coins for 24hrs;
[*]Powerful Extension - Transform into snowmen and kill 200 players to get a powerful extension;
[*]Xmas Chest - Collect 30 candies to get a Sapphire Chest.
[/list]

[i]Santa's Boots stats: Life 11%, Armor 8%, Speed 21%, Haste 10%.[/i]

[u][b]During all the Xmas event every purchase gets double coins![/b][/u]

Thank you for playing Strike.is and
Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

Strike.is Staff

notes.title: Season 4 Announcement + Last halloween days!
notes.content:
Dear Player,

The new season has begun and you are already fighting to dominate the ranks :)

We have just introduced a new weapon called the Sonic Gun.

This weapon will allow better teamplaying due to his healing capabilities. The weapon provides two passive powers that you can switch:

- Healing power of the music: +10% life regeneration to all nearby friends
- Frenzy power of the music: +10% speed to all nearby friends

The healing mode special power will heal all nearby friendly players, and the frenzy mode special power will blast an enemy with sonic waves pushing him away from you!

Let us know what do you think and have fun!
The Freakinware Team!

notes.content:

In this update we have separated quick play players among competitive/guild wars (in short, no longer unregistered players in competitive matches).

We have also raised the magazine of Granade Launcher to 6 and decreased the shoot time to 300ms.

We are also working hardly in order to suppress the lag spikes affecting some of the players.

Have fun!
Strike.is Team

notes.title: Season 2 Announcement!
notes.content:
Dear Player,

** Notice that the W to move forward option will be enabled by default on Monday, to disable this option check your settings screen **

Season 2 has begun! Discover all the new features:

- New Default Game Mode: Quick Play
  As for now, Free For All was the default game mode in Strike.is, starting from season 2
  the game modes will be: Quick Play, Competitive Play, Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch and Guild Wars.
  
  Quick Play will now pick a random game mode between Control Zone, Capture The Flag, Team Fortress and
  Team Deathmatch.  

- New Competitive Play
  Until now the only way to play competitive matches was in guild, starting from season 9
  players can play competitive matches in solo or in a party. Winning or losing a
  competitive game will increase or decrease your personal rating, which is the same used
  in guild wars. There will be a new player ranks too!
  
- Weapons:

1) New Weapons: Laser Gun, Granade Launcher and Crossbow!
2) Weapons can now include a third power that can be activated using the power switch button!

- New Game Modes: Control Zone and Capture The Flag!
- New Maps with Teleport zones!

- Equipment System:
  In Season 2 you will be able to increase your armor, life regen, damage, speed and weapon
  mastery trought the equipment system! You will be also able to increase your weapon powers
  in the items store!

- New Daily Quests and Achievements, which will allow you to obtain lot of coins!

- New Guild features:

1) Guild War CO-OP
   Until now guild wars have been unoptimized, due to guild playing with only 2 players
   against 4 or more players. Starting from season 9 guilds can be inserted in the same team
   to fight against other guilds in the same number. Players playing in competitive mode can be
   inserted in a guild team too. The guild owner can disable the external collaboration option in the
   guild settings
 
2) Guild Server
   The guild owner will be able to change the server in the settings screen.

3) Guild Advertising
   The guild owner will be able to advertise the guild to make it appear first in the guild search
   page. The first time is free.

4) Improved Match results
   When a Guild War or a competitive match ends there will be displayed more detailed statistics about
   the ended game.

6) Guild Search
   Now you'll be able to search for a particular guild in the "Find a Guild" screen.

7) Friend Search
   Likewise the guilds search you'll be able to filter your friends in the Friend List in the right panel.

8) Emeralds
   While in the special daily game mode players can collect diamonds, in guild wars and competitive 
   matches players will be able to collect emeralds and exchange them from coins.

This update will also incluse tons of bug fixes and improvements.

EDIT: 
The update is already online, in the upcoming days we will balance the game and fix all reported bugs.

Thank you, and have fun!
Freakinware Team

notes.title: Update Announcement - August 8th
notes.content:
Dear Players,

On August 8th we will release the first big patch for Strike.is: The Game. 

It will include:

- Weapon Leveling sytem

During each play session you will gain weapon experience (killing players and doing damage), this will increase your weapon power. Each play session will start with Weapon level 1 (weapon level is not permanent).

- New game mode: Capture The Flag
- New weapons: Granade Launcher, Crossbow and Laser Gun
- New maps with teleport spots.
- Achievements and quests

Let us know what do you think,
Stay tuned!

The Freakinware Team
